text: Gentlemen. We told the robot to stop on a bridge. It stopped. On the bridge.
Last week's model builds backwards. We say stop, it lets go of sneak, and keeps walking backwards. Right off its own bridge. This week's model. Same stop. It stays put.
Last week's tests caught it by watching the robot fall into the void. It is an old bug. The robot tested the void for us. The void works.
Now the stop lets go of the back key too. Six stops out of six. Three out of three across a gap. Fifteen minutes of real play, zero deaths.
Version zero point nine five point five nine. Out now. It stays where you put it.
